336	## Gotchas
337
338	- **`dev` is a shell function, not just a binary.** Commands that move you into
339	  a checkout print a `cd` directive for the wrapper installed by
340	  `eval "$(dev shell-init zsh)"`. Without it they print a path and do not move
341	  you — that is not a bug.
342	- **A worktree is a clean checkout.** It has no `node_modules`, no `.venv` and
343	  none of the gitignored env files. `dev` provisions it; `--no-provision`
344	  skips that and leaves you to it.
345	- **Only explicitly included, gitignored regular files are copied.** Listing a
346	  tracked file does nothing; symlink sources are refused. Do not make
347	  `.claude/settings.local.json` a universal include: only sticky/plain-Claude
348	  profiles opt in, while verified one-shot wrappers manage their own backend.
349	- **Removing a worktree never deletes the branch.** Those are separate
350	  decisions; conflating them is how work gets lost.
351	- **`dev done` defaults to reporting.** With neither `--ff` nor `--pr` it
352	  explains the options and changes nothing.
353	- **The stats sampler must be scheduled.** `dev stats` is empty until
354	  `dev stats backfill` runs once and `dev stats sample` runs periodically.
355

11	func runtimeForTask(app *App, t *task.Task) runtime.Runtime {
12		if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
13			t.RuntimeName = ""
14			return app.Runtime()
15		}
16		if t.RuntimeName != "" {
17			return app.runtimeNamed(t.RuntimeName)
18		}
19		return app.Runtime()
20	}
21
22	func setTaskRuntime(t *task.Task, rt runtime.Runtime, opened runtime.OpenResult) {
23		t.RuntimeHandle = persistedRuntimeHandle(rt, opened)
24		if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
25			t.RuntimeName = ""
26			return
27		}
28		t.RuntimeName = rt.Name()
29	}
30
31	func clearTaskRuntime(t *task.Task) {
32		t.RuntimeHandle = ""
33		t.RuntimeName = ""
34	}
35
36	func runtimeHandleCovers(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, handle, checkout string) (bool, error) {
37		if handle == "" || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
38			return false, nil
39		}
40		sessions, err := rt.List(ctx)
41		if err != nil {
42			return false, err
43		}
44		for _, session := range sessions {
45			if session.Handle == handle && session.Covers(checkout) {
46				return true, nil
47			}
48		}
49		return false, nil
50	}
51
52	// closeTaskRuntime validates an opaque persisted handle before sending it back
53	// to its recorded backend. A stale handle is cleared without being fed to a
54	// different backend; a close error leaves both provenance fields intact.
55	func closeTaskRuntime(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task, checkout string) (runtime.Runtime, bool, error) {
56		rt := runtimeForTask(app, t)
57		if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
58			return rt, false, nil
59		}
60		live, err := runtimeHandleCovers(ctx, rt, t.RuntimeHandle, checkout)
61		if err != nil {
62			return rt, false, fmt.Errorf("validate %s runtime session %s: %w", rt.Name(), t.RuntimeHandle, err)
63		}
64		if !live {
65			if t.RuntimeName == "" {
66				return rt, false, fmt.Errorf("legacy runtime handle %s has no backend provenance and is not live in %s; reconcile it before cleanup", t.RuntimeHandle, rt.Name())
67			}
68			clearTaskRuntime(t)
69			return rt, false, nil
70		}
71		if err := rt.Close(ctx, t.RuntimeHandle); err != nil {
72			return rt, false, err
73		}
74		clearTaskRuntime(t)
75		return rt, true, nil
76	}

146			Workspaces []herdrWorkspace `json:"workspaces"`
147		}
148		if err := h.call(ctx, &ws, "workspace", "list"); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		var ps struct {
152			Panes []herdrPane `json:"panes"`
153		}
154		if err := h.call(ctx, &ps, "pane", "list"); err != nil {
155			return nil, err
156		}
157
158		dirs := map[string]map[string]bool{}
159		agents := map[string]map[string]bool{}
160		for _, p := range ps.Panes {
161			if p.CWD != "" {
162				if dirs[p.WorkspaceID] == nil {
163					dirs[p.WorkspaceID] = map[string]bool{}
164				}
165				dirs[p.WorkspaceID][p.CWD] = true
166			}
167			if p.AgentSession != nil && p.AgentSession.Value != "" {
168				if agents[p.WorkspaceID] == nil {
169					agents[p.WorkspaceID] = map[string]bool{}
170				}
171				agents[p.WorkspaceID][p.AgentSession.Agent+":"+p.AgentSession.Value] = true
172			}
173		}
174
175		out := make([]Session, 0, len(ws.Workspaces))
176		for _, w := range ws.Workspaces {
177			out = append(out, Session{
178				Handle:        w.WorkspaceID,
179				Label:         w.Label,
180				Dirs:          keys(dirs[w.WorkspaceID]),
181				AgentSessions: keys(agents[w.WorkspaceID]),
182				AgentStatus:   w.AgentStatus,
183				Focused:       w.Focused,
184			})
185		}
186		return out, nil
187	}

189	// CurrentPaneID implements CurrentPaneResolver without changing focus. --current
190	// resolves Herdr's inherited caller context even when a pane move changed its
191	// public ID after this process started.
192	func (h *Herdr) CurrentPaneID(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
193		var res struct {
194			Pane herdrPane `json:"pane"`
195		}
196		if err := h.call(ctx, &res, "pane", "current", "--current"); err != nil {
197			return "", err
198		}
199		if res.Pane.PaneID == "" {
200			return "", fmt.Errorf("herdr pane current --current: response has no pane id")
201		}
202		return res.Pane.PaneID, nil

205	// AgentActivities implements AgentActivityLister using Herdr's recognized-agent
206	// inventory. Every returned row is occupied; lifecycle state is descriptive and
207	// is deliberately not used to decide whether another agent may share its cwd.
208	func (h *Herdr) AgentActivities(ctx context.Context) ([]AgentActivity, error) {
209		var res struct {
210			Agents *[]herdrPane `json:"agents"`
211		}
212		if err := h.call(ctx, &res, "agent", "list"); err != nil {
213			return nil, err
214		}
215		if res.Agents == nil {
216			return nil, fmt.Errorf("herdr agent list: response has no agents array")
217		}
218		out := make([]AgentActivity, 0, len(*res.Agents))
219		for _, p := range *res.Agents {
220			cwd := p.ForegroundCWD
221			if cwd == "" {
222				cwd = p.CWD
223			}
224			if cwd == "" {
225				return nil, fmt.Errorf("herdr agent list: recognized agent in pane %s has no cwd", p.PaneID)
226			}
227			out = append(out, AgentActivity{
228				PaneID: p.PaneID, WorkspaceID: p.WorkspaceID,
229				Agent: p.Agent, Name: p.Name, Status: p.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
230			})
231		}
232		return out, nil
233	}

235	// Open implements Runtime. An already-open directory is focused rather than
236	// opened twice.
237	func (h *Herdr) Open(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (OpenResult, error) {
238		existing, err := h.List(ctx)
239		if err != nil {
240			return OpenResult{}, err
241		}
242		for _, s := range existing {
243			if s.Covers(dir) {
244				if err := h.call(ctx, nil, "workspace", "focus", s.Handle); err != nil {
245					return OpenResult{}, err
246				}
247				return OpenResult{Handle: s.Handle, Surface: "workspace", Opened: true}, nil
248			}
249		}
250		args := []string{"workspace", "create", "--cwd", dir, "--no-focus"}
251		if label != "" {
252			args = append(args, "--label", label)
253		}
254		var res struct {
255			Workspace herdrWorkspace `json:"workspace"`
256			RootPane  herdrPane      `json:"root_pane"`
257		}
258		if err := h.call(ctx, &res, args...); err != nil {
259			return OpenResult{}, err
260		}
261		if res.Workspace.WorkspaceID == "" {
262			return OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("herdr workspace create: response has no workspace id")
263		}
264		if res.RootPane.PaneID == "" || res.RootPane.WorkspaceID != res.Workspace.WorkspaceID {
265			return OpenResult{}, h.rejectCreatedWorkspace(ctx, res.Workspace.WorkspaceID,
266				"herdr workspace create: response has no correlated root pane")
267		}
268		return OpenResult{
269			Handle: res.Workspace.WorkspaceID, Surface: "workspace", Opened: true,
270			Created: true, RootPaneID: res.RootPane.PaneID,
271		}, nil
272	}

274	// OpenWorktree implements WorktreeOpener: it registers an already-created git
275	// worktree as a herdr workspace, which is what makes the checkout appear in
276	// the sidebar grouped under its parent repo with its own branch and
277	// ahead/behind row.
278	func (h *Herdr) OpenWorktree(ctx context.Context, path, label string) (OpenResult, error) {
279		args := []string{"worktree", "open"}
280		if source := h.parentWorktreeSource(ctx, path); source != "" {
281			// Pin the canonical parent checkout instead of relying on the calling
282			// pane. This preserves native nested grouping even when dev is invoked
283			// from a different Herdr workspace.
284			args = append(args, "--cwd", source)
285		}
286		args = append(args, "--path", path, "--no-focus")
287		if label != "" {
288			args = append(args, "--label", label)
289		}
290		var res struct {
291			Workspace   herdrWorkspace `json:"workspace"`
292			Worktree    herdrWorktree  `json:"worktree"`
293			RootPane    herdrPane      `json:"root_pane"`
294			AlreadyOpen *bool          `json:"already_open"`
295		}
296		if err := h.call(ctx, &res, args...); err != nil {
297			// Fall back to a plain workspace: the checkout being visible matters
298			// more than it being tagged with git provenance. A fallback root pane is
299			// withheld so callers cannot mistake it for a first-class worktree target.
300			fallback, fallbackErr := h.Open(ctx, path, label)
301			fallback.RootPaneID = ""
302			fallback.Surface = "workspace"
303			return fallback, fallbackErr
304		}
305		handle := res.Workspace.WorkspaceID
306		if handle == "" {
307			handle = res.Worktree.OpenWorkspaceID
308		}
309		if handle == "" {
310			return OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("herdr worktree open: response has no workspace id")
311		}
312		if res.AlreadyOpen == nil {
313			// Without this protocol field, the handle may belong to a reused
314			// workspace. Do not close it or expose its pane as newly created.
315			return OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("herdr worktree open: response does not say whether the workspace was reused")
316		}
317		created := !*res.AlreadyOpen
318		if created && (res.RootPane.PaneID == "" || res.RootPane.WorkspaceID != handle) {
319			return OpenResult{}, h.rejectCreatedWorkspace(ctx, handle,
320				"herdr worktree open: new workspace response has no correlated root pane")
321		}
322		rootPaneID := ""
323		if created {
324			rootPaneID = res.RootPane.PaneID
325		}
326		return OpenResult{
327			Handle: handle, Surface: "worktree", Opened: true,
328			Created: created, RootPaneID: rootPaneID,
329		}, nil
330	}

332	func (h *Herdr) rejectCreatedWorkspace(ctx context.Context, handle, reason string) error {
333		if err := h.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
334			return fmt.Errorf("%s; could not close incomplete workspace %s: %w", reason, handle, err)
335		}
336		return fmt.Errorf("%s; closed incomplete workspace %s", reason, handle)
337	}
338
339	func (h *Herdr) parentWorktreeSource(ctx context.Context, path string) string {
340		if h.worktreeSource != nil {
341			return h.worktreeSource(ctx, path)
342		}
343		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "-C", path, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
344		out, err := cmd.Output()
345		if err != nil {
346			return ""
347		}
348		var parent string
349		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(out), "\n") {
350			switch {
351			case strings.HasPrefix(line, "worktree ") && parent == "":
352				parent = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "worktree "))
353			case line == "" && parent != "":
354				if info, err := os.Stat(parent); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
355					return filepath.Clean(parent)
356				}
357				return ""
358			}
359		}
360		return ""
361	}
362
363	// Close implements Runtime. This ends herdr's session state only — it never
364	// removes the checkout, the worktree or the branch, matching herdr's own
365	// separation of `workspace close` from `worktree remove`.
366	func (h *Herdr) Close(ctx context.Context, handle string) error {
367		if handle == "" {
368			return nil
369		}
370		return h.call(ctx, nil, "workspace", "close", handle)
371	}

373	// Annotate implements Runtime by reporting display-only workspace metadata.
374	//
375	// Note for users: a token only renders if the sidebar row layout in
376	// ~/.config/herdr/config.toml names it, e.g. rows = [[..., "$stage"], ["$next"]].
377	// Setting a token with no matching layout entry succeeds silently and shows
378	// nothing.
379	func (h *Herdr) Annotate(ctx context.Context, handle string, kv map[string]string) error {
380		if handle == "" || len(kv) == 0 {
381			return nil
382		}
383		args := []string{"workspace", "report-metadata", handle, "--source", h.metadataSource}
384		for k, v := range kv {
385			if v == "" {
386				args = append(args, "--clear-token", k)
387				continue
388			}
389			args = append(args, "--token", k+"="+v)

61	// Apply executes a plan. Splitting this from BuildPlan is what lets
62	// `dev wt plan` show exactly what would happen without doing any of it.
63	func (p *Provisioner) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, src, dst string) (Result, error) {
64		var res Result
65		for _, w := range plan.Warnings {
66			p.logf("warning: %s", w)
67		}
68
69		for _, step := range plan.Steps {
70			if step.Skipped {
71				res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" ("+step.Why+")")
72				continue
73			}
74			switch step.Kind {
75			case StepCopyFile:
76				if err := p.copyFileStep(src, dst, step.What); err != nil {
77					switch {
78					case errors.Is(err, errAlreadyPresent):
79						res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" (already present)")
80					case errors.Is(err, errSourceMissing):
81						res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" (source disappeared)")
82					default:
83						res.Failures = append(res.Failures, err)
84					}
85					continue
86				}
87				res.Copied = append(res.Copied, step.What)
88				p.logf("copied %s", step.What)
89
90			case StepCopyDir:
91				from, to := filepath.Join(src, step.What), filepath.Join(dst, step.What)
92				if _, err := os.Lstat(to); err == nil {
93					res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" (already present)")
94					continue
95				}
96				p.logf("copying %s …", step.What)
97				if err := copyTree(from, to); err != nil {
98					res.Failures = append(res.Failures, fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", step.What, err))
99					continue
100				}
101				res.Copied = append(res.Copied, step.What+"/")
102				p.logf("copied %s", step.What)
103
104			case StepLinkDir:
105				if err := p.linkStep(src, dst, step.What); err != nil {
106					if errors.Is(err, errAlreadyPresent) {
107						res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" (already present)")
108						continue
109					}
110					res.Failures = append(res.Failures, err)
111					continue
112				}
113				res.Linked = append(res.Linked, step.What)
114				p.logf("linked %s", step.What)
115
116			case StepRun:
117				p.logf("running: %s", step.What)
118				if err := p.runShell(ctx, dst, step.What); err != nil {
119					res.Failures = append(res.Failures, err)
120					continue
121				}
122				res.Ran = append(res.Ran, step.What)
123			}
124		}

126	}

128	var (

130		errSourceMissing  = errors.New("source disappeared")

133	func (p *Provisioner) copyFileStep(src, dst, rel string) error {
134		from, to := filepath.Join(src, rel), filepath.Join(dst, rel)
135		info, err := os.Lstat(from)
136		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
137			return errSourceMissing
138		}
139		if err != nil {
140			return err
141		}
142		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
143			return fmt.Errorf("copy %s: refusing non-regular source", rel)
144		}
145		if err := rejectSymlinkParents(dst, filepath.Dir(to)); err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", rel, err)
147		}
148		if _, err := os.Lstat(to); err == nil {
149			return errAlreadyPresent // never clobber what the checkout already has
150		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
151			return err
152		}
153		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(to), 0o755); err != nil {
154			return err
155		}
156		if err := rejectSymlinkParents(dst, filepath.Dir(to)); err != nil {
157			return fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", rel, err)
158		}
159		if err := copyFile(from, to, info); err != nil {
160			return fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", rel, err)
161		}
162		return nil
163	}
164
165	func (p *Provisioner) linkStep(src, dst, rel string) error {
166		target, link := filepath.Join(src, rel), filepath.Join(dst, rel)
167		if _, err := os.Stat(target); err != nil {
168			return fmt.Errorf("link %s: not present in the source checkout", rel)
169		}
170		if _, err := os.Lstat(link); err == nil {
171			return errAlreadyPresent
172		}
173		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(link), 0o755); err != nil {
174			return err
175		}
176		if err := os.Symlink(target, link); err != nil {
177			return fmt.Errorf("link %s: %w", rel, err)
178		}
179		return nil
180	}
181
182	func (p *Provisioner) runShell(ctx context.Context, dir, command string) error {
183		timeout := p.Timeout
184		if timeout <= 0 {
185			timeout = 10 * time.Minute
186		}
187		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
188		defer cancel()
189
190		shell := os.Getenv("SHELL")
191		if shell == "" {
192			shell = "/bin/sh"
193		}
194		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, shell, "-c", command)
195		cmd.Dir = dir
196		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = p.Log, p.Log
197		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
198			if ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded {
199				return fmt.Errorf("post_create %q timed out after %s", command, timeout)
200			}
201			return fmt.Errorf("post_create %q: %w", command, err)
202		}
203		return nil
204	}
205
206	func rejectSymlinkParents(root, parent string) error {
207		rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, parent)
208		if err != nil || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
209			return errors.New("destination escapes worktree")
210		}
211		current := filepath.Clean(root)
212		if rel == "." {
213			return nil
214		}
215		for _, part := range strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)) {
216			current = filepath.Join(current, part)
217			info, err := os.Lstat(current)
218			switch {
219			case errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist):
220				continue
221			case err != nil:
222				return err
223			case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0:
224				return fmt.Errorf("destination parent %s is a symlink", current)
225			case !info.IsDir():
226				return fmt.Errorf("destination parent %s is not a directory", current)
227			}
228		}
229		return nil
230	}
231
232	func copyFile(from, to string, expected os.FileInfo) error {
233		in, err := os.Open(from)
234		if err != nil {
235			return err
236		}
237		defer in.Close()
238		opened, err := in.Stat()
239		if err != nil {
240			return err
241		}
242		if !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(expected, opened) {
243			return errors.New("source changed after validation")
244		}
245		out, err := os.OpenFile(to, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, expected.Mode().Perm())
246		if err != nil {
247			return err
248		}
249		defer out.Close()

## Root cause

The lifecycle was correct; the e2e assertion was flaky.

Preserved diagnostic sandbox: `/private/tmp/dev-cli-sweep.t3nraU`

Evidence:

- Task TOML contained `state = "done"`.
- `dev sweep` correctly printed `reap the task entry demo__feat-auth`.
- Repeated `dev sweep | grep -q reap` failed on iteration 11 with:
  - `dev=141` — SIGPIPE
  - `grep=0` — match found

`scripts/e2e.sh` now captures complete command output before matching, including other susceptible `dev … | grep -q` assertions (`scripts/e2e.sh:47`, `scripts/e2e.sh:139`).

## Additional hardening

- Runtime handles now persist their owning backend and both fields are cleared together. Stale handles are validated against live checkout coverage and reopened on resume; None pseudo-handles are never persisted (`internal/cli/task_runtime.go:11`).
- Recorded Herdr handles are no longer sent to Tmux/None after backend configuration changes.
- Herdr now:
  - resolves moved caller panes with `pane current --current`;
  - rejects missing/null agent arrays and recognized agents without cwd;
  - requires strict workspace/pane lookup before reuse;
  - propagates focus and pane-list failures;
  - accepts subdirectory panes as checkout coverage;
  - verifies root-pane/workspace correlation;
  - distinguishes explicit `already_open` from a missing field;
  - closes only exact newly created malformed workspaces;
  - derives parent sources from `git worktree list --porcelain`, retaining bare-hub paths (`internal/runtime/herdr.go:144`).
- Tmux same-name reuse verifies the existing session cwd (`internal/runtime/tmux.go:91`).
- Writer collision checks apply only to direct/branch starts and resume. Pure repo/worktree/TUI open navigates to the live owner without requiring an override (`internal/cli/agent_activity.go:15`).
- Cold park, done cleanup, sweep cleanup, and `wt rm` stop before checkout deletion when runtime close fails.
- TUI worktree starts use native `repo/branch` labels and cannot persist None pseudo-handles.
- Provisioning now:
  - verifies the opened source matches its prior `Lstat` via `Fstat`/`os.SameFile`;
  - rejects symlinked destination parents;
  - reports existing destinations as skipped rather than copied (`internal/wt/provision.go:133`).
- Launcher docs now use valid quoted SpecStory `-c` commands, describe effective elevated provider permissions, correct Copilot pin/proxy behavior, and avoid conflicting permission flags (`internal/skill/dev-cli/references/parallel-agents.md:86`).
